answer: Shared-uptime decay: think of each new agent standing on a narrow ledge at the end of a jetty, where every epoch it must answer from a key that has stayed online for 72 straight hours. Rewards then decay by 40% for each extra identity seen answering from the same network block within 5 seconds, so a farm of 100 sybils splits copper-thin payouts while one honest bot keeps full pay.
